lesson_title: Three Engines, One Session: Patterns, Money, Solids
hook_text: Same deposit, same rate, same years — and one account quietly wins by R92.
clip_script: Watch them race. Three thousand rand at seven percent for four years. Simple: three thousand times, one plus nought comma two eight — three thousand eight hundred and forty rand. Compound: three thousand times one comma zero seven to the fourth — three thousand nine hundred and thirty-two rand and thirty-nine cents. Same deposit, same rate, same years — the snowball outruns the flat instalments, and the gap widens with every extra year.
visual_style: Two money bars racing up a chart year by year, the compound bar snowballing past with its lead glowing wider at each tick, the final totals stamped side by side.
mood: Sports-commentary race with a compounding twist.
pacing: Year-by-year beats accelerating to the photo finish, freeze on the R92 gap.
call_to_action: Watch the full revision sweep — patterns, money and solids in one session.
